hero.title: AI Agent 上下文工程完整指南
hero.en:
Your AI agent works great for the first 10 steps.
Then somewhere around step 15, it starts getting sloppy.
Wrong tool calls. Forgetting your original instructions. Low-quality outputs.
Most people
hero.zh: 上下文工程不是把窗口塞满，而是决定哪些信息写入、选择、压缩和隔离，才能让长任务 Agent 保持可靠。

summary.lead: 这篇资料的核心判断是：Agent 长任务质量下降通常不是模型本身突然变差，而是上下文窗口中可见信息的组织方式失控；上下文工程要在正确时间给模型正确信息。

cards.title: 问题起点
cards.body: Agent 在多步执行后会出现错用工具、遗忘原始指令、输出质量下降；原文把根因指向“模型正在看到什么”。

cards.title: 窗口约束
cards.body: 上下文窗口像 RAM，系统提示词、工具定义、工具结果、检索知识、会话历史、记忆和状态都在争用有限空间。

cards.title: 四类策略
cards.body: Write、Select、Compress、Isolate 分别解决遗忘、过载、累积和污染问题，是原文组织所有上下文工程技术的主框架。

cards.title: 失败诊断
cards.body: Context Poisoning、Distraction、Confusion、Clash 四类失败模式帮助定位 Agent 为什么在长上下文中失效。

cards.title: 工程落点
cards.body: 系统提示词要定义 Agent 架构，KV-cache 要求稳定内容放在前面，复杂工作流应通过频繁有意压缩分阶段推进。

keyPoints.label: 核心判断
keyPoints.text: 上下文工程不是提示词工程的替代口号，而是面向 Agent 长任务可靠性的上下文选择、排序、压缩和隔离机制。

keyPoints.label: 设计原则
keyPoints.text: 不要把大窗口当作可以填满的仓库；原文强调退化会在硬性上限之前连续发生，并伴随 Lost in the Middle 问题。

keyPoints.label: 实践路径
keyPoints.text: 把稳定规则和阶段产物写到外部，按步骤检索必要信息，主动压缩过时上下文，并用子 Agent 或状态 schema 隔离不同任务。

nodes.label: 症状：长任务变差
nodes.summary: Agent 前几步正常，随后出现错误工具调用、遗忘指令和低质量输出。

nodes.label: 根因：看到的信息失控
nodes.summary: 原文认为多数问题不在模型本身，而在模型当前上下文中看到的信息。

nodes.label: 约束：窗口像 RAM
nodes.summary: 上下文窗口有限且会随输入长度增加而逐步退化，不是到硬限制才突然失效。

nodes.label: 竞争：七类内容争用空间
nodes.summary: 系统提示词、工具定义、工具结果、RAG 内容、会话历史、记忆和 Agent 状态同时占用窗口。

nodes.label: 策略：写入、选择、压缩、隔离
nodes.summary: 四类策略分别控制信息持久化、即时相关性、token 密度和任务边界。

nodes.label: 诊断：四种失败模式
nodes.summary: 投毒、分心、混淆和冲突为上下文失败提供可命名、可修复的分类。

nodes.label: 提示词：定义 Agent 架构
nodes.summary: Agent 系统提示词要写控制流、工具使用、错误处理和护栏，而不只是设定语气。

nodes.label: 成本：稳定前缀服务 KV-cache
nodes.summary: 把稳定内容放在上下文顶部、动态内容放在底部，可以提高缓存命中并降低成本。

nodes.label: 工作流：分阶段压缩
nodes.summary: 研究、计划、实现等阶段通过压缩产物衔接，每一阶段用更干净的上下文继续推进。

sections.toc: 问题不是模型，而是模型看到什么
sections.title: 问题不是模型，而是模型看到什么

rows.en: Your AI agent works great for the first 10 steps.
rows.zh: 你的 AI Agent 在前 10 步表现很好。

rows.en: It's what the model is seeing.
rows.zh: 关键在于模型正在看到什么。

rows.en: Put simply: make sure your agent sees the right information, in the right format, at the right time.
rows.zh: 上下文工程的实际目标，是让 Agent 在正确时间、以正确格式看到正确的信息。

sections.toc: 为什么提示词工程不足以支撑 Agent
sections.title: 为什么提示词工程不足以支撑 Agent

rows.en: A chatbot answers one question and stops.
rows.zh: 聊天机器人通常回答一个问题就结束，因此清晰指令、示例和角色设定往往足够。

rows.en: An agent takes actions — browsing the web, calling APIs, writing code, running commands — step after step after step, sometimes for dozens of steps.
rows.zh: Agent 会连续浏览网页、调用 API、写代码、运行命令；每一步产生的新输出都会进入上下文，问题随步骤累积。

rows.en: Prompt engineering is a subset of context engineering.
rows.zh: 原文没有否定提示词本身，而是把提示词工程放入更大的上下文工程范畴中。

sections.toc: 上下文窗口像 RAM，会提前退化
sections.title: 上下文窗口像 RAM，会提前退化

rows.en: The context window is RAM — the working memory where everything the model can currently see and reason about lives.
rows.zh: 上下文窗口被类比为 RAM：它是模型当前能看到、能推理的工作记忆。

rows.en: Every single model's performance degraded as input length increased.
rows.zh: 随着输入长度增加，每一个模型的表现都会下降。

rows.en: Your original instructions — buried under 50,000 tokens of tool outputs — effectively disappear.
rows.zh: 当原始指令被大量工具输出埋到上下文中部时，会因为注意力分布问题而实际“消失”。

sections.toc: 七类信息争用同一个窗口
sections.title: 七类信息争用同一个窗口

rows.en: 7 categories. All fighting for the same finite window.
rows.zh: 原文把上下文空间竞争拆成七类内容，强调它们都在争用同一个有限窗口。

rows.en: 1. System Prompt
rows.zh: 原文列出的七类竞争内容从系统提示词开始；后续还包括工具定义、工具调用结果、RAG、会话历史、记忆和 Agent 状态。

rows.en: Context engineering is deciding what wins.
rows.zh: 上下文工程的关键不是全部塞入，而是决定当前阶段哪些信息应当优先进入窗口。

rows.en: Every technique you will ever learn fits into one of these.
rows.zh: 你之后学到的每一种技巧，几乎都可以归入这四类之一。

rows.en: Write means giving the agent ways to persist information outside the context window.
rows.zh: Write 解决遗忘：让 Agent 把中间发现、规则和长期记忆持久化到窗口之外。

rows.en: Don't give the agent everything. Give it what it needs right now.
rows.zh: Select 解决过载：不要给 Agent 一切，只给当前步骤真正需要的内容。

sections.toc: 压缩与隔离控制累积和污染
sections.title: 压缩与隔离控制累积和污染

rows.en: Even with good selection, context accumulates.
rows.zh: 即使选择机制做得好，上下文仍会因为工具调用、检索文档和决策记录不断累积。

rows.en: The goal: reduce token count. Preserve what actually matters.
rows.zh: Compress 的目标是减少 token 数量，同时保留真正重要的含义，而不是机械截断。

rows.en: Isolation means giving different parts of the work their own separate context windows.
rows.zh: Isolate 通过为不同阶段或子任务分配独立上下文，避免研究噪声污染实现阶段。

sections.toc: 四类失败模式：命名问题才能修复问题
sections.title: 四类失败模式：命名问题才能修复问题

rows.en: Every broken agent you've ever seen falls into one of these.
rows.zh: 原文认为常见的 Agent 失效可以归入四类上下文失败模式。

rows.en: A hallucination or error enters context.
rows.zh: 一旦幻觉或错误进入上下文，它就会污染后续步骤。

rows.en: Superfluous content leads the model to low-quality decisions.
rows.zh: Context Confusion 指无关内容过多，使模型虽然没有超出窗口，却无法清晰做出高质量决策。

sections.toc: Agent 系统提示词要定义架构
sections.title: Agent 系统提示词要定义架构

rows.en: A chatbot system prompt sets a tone.
rows.zh: 聊天机器人的系统提示词主要设定语气和互动风格。

rows.en: An agent system prompt defines architecture.
rows.zh: Agent 的系统提示词则要定义架构：任务控制流、工具使用时机、错误处理和护栏。

rows.en: Specific enough to guide autonomous behavior. Flexible enough for the model to apply judgment in novel situations.
rows.zh: 好的 Agent 提示词应当足够具体以指导自主行为，同时保留模型处理新情境的判断空间。

sections.toc: KV-cache 让上下文顺序变成成本问题
sections.title: KV-cache 让上下文顺序变成成本问题

rows.en: If the beginning of your context — the prefix — stays the same between API calls, the provider reuses the cached computation and only processes the new tokens at the end.
rows.zh: 如果上下文开头的稳定前缀在多次 API 调用之间保持不变，推理服务商可以复用缓存计算，只处理末尾新增 token。

rows.en: → Stable content goes at the TOP of context — system prompt, tool definitions, anything that doesn't change between turns
rows.zh: 原文给出的实践规则是：系统提示词、工具定义等稳定内容放在上下文顶部。

rows.en: → Dynamic content goes at the BOTTOM — conversation history, current step, agent state → Don't dynamically add and remove tools mid-conversation — it invalidates the cache
rows.zh: 会话历史、当前步骤和 Agent 状态等动态内容应放在底部，以减少对缓存前缀的破坏。

sections.toc: 可交付工作流：频繁有意压缩
sections.title: 可交付工作流：频繁有意压缩

rows.en: Structure agent work into phases. Each phase produces a compacted artifact. Each new phase starts with a fresh context window containing only that artifact.
rows.zh: 原文推荐把 Agent 工作拆成阶段：每个阶段产出压缩工件，下个阶段只带着这个工件开启新的上下文窗口。

rows.en: Phase 1 — Research
rows.zh: 示例工作流是研究、计划、实现三阶段；研究产物压缩为文档，计划接受人工审查，实现阶段再按计划执行。

rows.en: The result: a clean, focused agent at every phase. No contamination. No context rot. No "sloppy step 20."
rows.zh: 这样每个阶段的 Agent 都保持干净、聚焦，减少上下文污染、腐化和长任务后段变差。

sections.toc: 生产级 Agent 回合流水线
sections.title: 生产级 Agent 回合流水线

rows.en: Every serious platform converges on the same 5-step loop per agent turn:
rows.zh: 原文最后把严肃 Agent 平台的每回合处理归纳为五步循环。

rows.en: Collect — user input, conversation history, tool results, retrieved docs, agent state
rows.zh: 第一步是收集用户输入、对话历史、工具结果、检索文档和 Agent 状态。

rows.en: Select — what's relevant for this step within the remaining token budget
rows.zh: 第二步是在剩余 token 预算内选择当前步骤相关内容，随后再压缩、排列、组装并调用模型。

quiz.question: 原文认为 Agent 到多步任务后变差时，最常见的根因是什么？
options: 模型当前看到的信息组织不当
模型参数在运行中被改变
Agent 必须完全删除系统提示词
所有工具调用都应被禁止
quiz.explain: 原文说“几乎从来不是模型，而是模型正在看到什么”，并把组织模型所见内容定义为上下文工程。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他选项没有对应原文：文章没有说模型参数会变化，也没有主张删除系统提示词或禁止工具。
quiz.sourceAnchor: It's what the model is seeing.

quiz.question: 为什么原文说提示词工程不足以覆盖 Agent 场景？
options: 因为 Agent 会连续采取行动，每一步输出都会加入上下文
因为聊天机器人不能使用自然语言
因为所有 Agent 都只有一次模型调用
因为上下文窗口没有长度限制
quiz.explain: 原文区分 chatbot 和 agent：chatbot 回答一个问题就停止，而 Agent 会浏览网页、调用 API、写代码、运行命令，持续多步。
quiz.wrongReason: 干扰项与原文相反或无依据；原文强调上下文有限且 Agent 会多步执行。
quiz.sourceAnchor: A chatbot answers one question and stops.

quiz.question: “上下文窗口像 RAM”这个类比强调了什么？
options: 它是模型当前可见和可推理的信息工作区，填满后推理会退化
它会永久保存所有历史信息
它只存放最终答案，不存放工具结果
它越满越能提高模型注意力
quiz.explain: 原文把上下文窗口称为工作记忆，并指出像电脑 RAM 填满会变慢一样，上下文拥挤会降低 Agent 推理质量。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他选项都与原文不符：上下文不是永久存储，也会包含工具结果，变长会导致性能下降。

quiz.question: 下列哪一组是原文提出的四类上下文工程核心策略？
options: Write、Select、Compress、Isolate
Collect、Deploy、Monitor、Rollback
Prompt、Sample、Rank、Cache
Research、Code、Merge、Release
quiz.explain: 原文明确说 LangChain 框架把所有上下文工程技术组织为 Write、Select、Compress、Isolate 四个桶。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他组合是常见工程或模型相关动作，但不是这篇文章的四类上下文策略。

quiz.question: Context Poisoning 指的是什么？
options: 错误或幻觉进入上下文，并在后续步骤中被反复引用
上下文太短导致模型无法输出任何内容
工具定义被稳定放在上下文前缀
把研究阶段交给子 Agent 隔离执行
quiz.explain: 原文定义 Context Poisoning 为 hallucination 或 error 进入上下文后，Agent 在后续步骤中反复引用它。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他选项分别对应不同主题或与失败模式无关：稳定前缀是 KV-cache 策略，子 Agent 是隔离策略。

quiz.question: 为了提高 KV-cache 效率，原文建议如何排列上下文？
options: 稳定内容放顶部，动态内容放底部
每轮都重新排列系统提示词
动态内容放顶部，工具定义放底部
删除所有工具定义来保证前缀为空
quiz.explain: 原文建议 stable content goes at the TOP，dynamic content goes at the BOTTOM，以复用前缀缓存并减少重算。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他做法会破坏稳定前缀，或不是原文建议；文章还提到用 tool masking 而不是动态移除工具。
quiz.sourceAnchor: Stable content goes at the TOP of context

rows.caption: 来源图片 2，来自 X 原文。

rows.en:
LangChain has the right analogy for this.

Think of an LLM like a new kind of operating system.

The model is the CPU — it does the thinking.

The context window is RAM — the working memory where everything the model can currently see and reason about lives.

Just like your computer slows down when RAM fills up, your agent's reasoning degrades when the context window gets crowded.

This is called context rot.

Chroma ran a study evaluating 18 frontier models — GPT-4.1, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, Qwen3, and others.

Think of an LLM like a new kind of operating system.

The model is the CPU — it does the thinking.

The context window is RAM — the working memory where everything the model can currently see and reason about lives.

rows.en:
Why? Transformers work by having every token attend to every other token — creating n-squared relationships. As context grows, the model's ability to hold all those relationships thins out.

And then there's the "Lost in the Middle" problem.

LLMs show a U-shaped attention curve.

→ Beginning of context: remembered well

→ End of context: remembered well

→ Middle: largely ignored

Researchers measured a 30+ percentage point accuracy drop when relevant information moved from the beginning of context to the middle.
rows.zh:
为什么？Transformer 的工作方式是让每个 token 关注其他每个 token，从而形成平方级关系。随着上下文增长，模型维持所有这些关系的能力会被稀释。

还有“中间遗失”问题。

LLM 呈现出 U 形注意力曲线。

→ 上下文开头：记得很好

→ 上下文结尾：记得很好

→ 中间部分：很大程度上被忽略

研究人员测得，当相关信息从上下文开头移到中间时，准确率会下降 30 多个百分点。

When an agent's context fills up and gets compacted, it loses information.

If the agent didn't write anything down before that happened — that information is gone forever.

Write means giving the agent ways to persist information outside the context window.

Three forms:

Give the agent a tool that lets it take notes during a task. Intermediate findings. Decisions made. Information it knows it will need later.

Anthropic built a "think" tool — a dedicated space for Claude to work through problems.

rows.en:
An agent with 40 tools, a large knowledge base, and several sessions of history cannot load all of that at once.

Something has to decide what's relevant for this step.

Traditional RAG: the system decides.

User asks → retrieve documents → stuff into prompt → done.

Static. One-shot. The model has no say.

Agentic RAG: the agent decides. It searches for what it needs, refines queries, picks tools, determines when it has enough information.

Here is the deeper problem with long agent runs.

It's not just space. It's contamination.

The detailed file searches from the research phase are still sitting in context when the agent moves to writing code.

That old research context is now noise. It's distracting the model during a phase where it needs to focus on clean implementation.

Isolation means giving different parts of the work their own separate context windows.

Every broken agent you've ever seen falls into one of these.

A hallucination or error enters context.

Fix: Validate tool outputs before they enter context. After recovering from an error, compress the failed-attempt history. Don't leave 10 steps of dead-end debugging visible when only the resolution matters.

━━━

Context gets so long the model starts over-relying on recent history.

Instead of synthesizing a novel plan, it just rehashes what it recently did.

It stops thinking. It starts repeating.

Superfluous content leads the model to low-quality decisions.

Classic example: a model failing on a benchmark when given 46 tools — even though the context was well within limits — but working fine with only 19 tools.

They were too many for the model to reason about clearly.

groups.group: How to Write System Prompts for Agents (Not chatbots. Agents.) · 如何为 Agent 编写系统提示词（不是聊天机器人，而是 Agent）

rows.caption: 来源图片 10，来自 X 原文。

rows.en:
A chatbot system prompt sets a tone.

"You are a helpful assistant. Be concise and friendly."

An agent system prompt defines architecture.

It specifies control flow — how to approach task types, which tools to use when, what to do on errors, what guardrails to follow.

It is closer to writing a job description for an autonomous employee than a personality prompt.

Anthropic calls it writing at the "right altitude."
rows.zh:
聊天机器人的系统提示词设定的是语气。

“你是一个有帮助的助手。保持简洁友好。”

Agent 的系统提示词定义的是架构。

它指定控制流：如何处理任务类型、什么时候使用哪些工具、出错时怎么办、遵循哪些防护规则。

它更像是在为一个自主员工写岗位说明，而不是写人格提示。

Anthropic 称之为在“正确高度”写作。

The sweet spot:Specific enough to guide autonomous behavior. Flexible enough for the model to apply judgment in novel situations. Strong heuristics. Not rigid rules.

Practical tips:

→ Organize with XML tags or markdown headers — Background, Instructions, Tool Guidance

→ Start minimal and iterate on failures — don't try to anticipate every edge case up front

→ Minimal doesn't mean short — a complex agent system prompt can be thousands of tokens and that's fine as long as every token earns its place

rows.caption: 来源图片 11，来自 X 原文。

rows.en:
Most agent builders don't know this exists.

When you send tokens to an LLM, the model computes key-value representations for each token.

Computationally expensive.

So inference providers cache these representations.

这在计算上很昂贵。

所以推理服务商会缓存这些表示。

rows.en:
If the beginning of your context — the prefix — stays the same between API calls, the provider reuses the cached computation and only processes the new tokens at the end.

Fast. Cheap.

rows.en:
Dex Horthy (CEO of HumanLayer) presented this at the AI Engineer Code Summit.

His team reportedly used it to ship ~35,000 lines of code to a large Rust codebase in one 7-hour session.

The method: Frequent Intentional Compaction.

Structure agent work into phases. Each phase produces a compacted artifact. Each new phase starts with a fresh context window containing only that artifact.

Stay deliberately below 40–60% of the context window at all times.

始终有意地保持在上下文窗口 40% 到 60% 以下。

rows.en:
Every serious platform converges on the same 5-step loop per agent turn:

→ Collect — user input, conversation history, tool results, retrieved docs, agent state

→ Select — what's relevant for this step within the remaining token budget

→ Compress — summarize, truncate, or restructure to fit the context → Arrange — stable content first (cache), dynamic content last

→ Assemble + call — final context → API call → get output → loop

→ 压缩：摘要、截断或重构以适配上下文。→ 排列：稳定内容在前（缓存），动态内容在后

→ 组装并调用：最终上下文 → API 调用 → 获取输出 → 循环

Context rot is real and starts well before your context limit.

The 4 strategies that fix it:

→ Write — persist info outside context so agents don't forget

→ Select — pull in only what's needed for this step

→ Compress — cut tokens, keep meaning, proactively not reactively

→ Isolate — separate contexts for separate jobs, no contamination

The 4 failure modes to watch for:

→ Poisoning — bad data compounds through every step

→ Distraction — long history makes agents rehash instead of think

→ 压缩：减少 token，保留含义；主动进行，而不是被动补救

→ 隔离：为不同工作分离上下文，避免污染

需要警惕的 4 种失败模式：

→ 投毒：坏数据会复合影响每一步

→ 分心：过长历史让 Agent 复述，而不是思考
